name: Enjo Kousai ~Arisa no Jouji~
original_name: 援女交際 ～亜梨紗の情事～
source:
Arisa is normal student with a dream of becoming famous actor in the future and has been attending famous acting school for years. Her parents are against it so she has been trying hard alone until now. After passing the exam to have a chance of going out to real performance for the first time as sub, she has to face a problem with money according to the rule set for non-main actors.

In despair, she reaches out for compensated dating where she meets protagonist - a salary man with only interest in high school girl compensated dating. Little did they know this fateful encounter will change their life forever.
translation:
亚里沙是一名普通学生，梦想着将来成为一名著名演员，多年来一直在著名的表演学校就读。父母反对，她一直一个人努力到现在。通过考试，获得第一次真正以替补身份演出的机会后，按照非主演的规则，她必须面对金钱的问题。

绝望中，她寻求补偿性约会，在那里她遇到了主角——一个只对高中女生补偿性约会感兴趣的工薪族。他们不知道这次命运的邂逅将永远改变他们的生活。
